Only `test_markdown_table` failed.

I'll double check the `Markdown` implementation in `rich/markdown.py` to see if there is anything that would cause the padding to be styled.

I already read `TableDataElement.on_text`.

```python
    def on_text(self, text: str, style: str = "") -> None:
        self.content.append(text, style)
```

And `TableDataElement.__init__`:

```python
    def __init__(self, justification: Justification) -> None:
        self.content = Text("", justify=justification)
```

The `Text` object is initialized with `justify=justification`.

If `markdown-it` provides the text in chunks, and the first chunk is the padding, then the padding will be appended with the default style.

If the second chunk is the italicized text, it will be appended with the italic style.

If the third chunk is the padding, it will be appended with the default style.

This is exactly what happened.
